title.en: Deploy Only on the Main Branch

hints.tr: Koşul: `if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`. Metinler tek tırnakla.
hints.en: The condition: `if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`. Text in single quotes.

hints.tr: `deploy:` öteki işlerle aynı hizada (iki boşluk), altındaki anahtarlar dört boşluk içeride.
hints.en: `deploy:` is in the same column as the other jobs (two spaces), the keys under it four spaces in.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install ruff
      - run: ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
  build:
    needs: [lint, test]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip wheel . -w dist
  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./deploy.sh
```
